verdict.rationale: Groq is a hosted LLM inference API, so a training-data opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions data retention, training use, or any opt-out control, so nothing supports the story. Missing for 10: any documented no-training policy, an opt-out setting, or data-retention controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
